title: (RHEA-2008:0402) xorg-x11-drv-mga enhancement update
portal_summary:
An updated xorg-x11-drv-mga driver which provides additional hardware
support is now available.

portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure that all previously-released
errata relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  Details on how to use
the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
http://kbase.redhat.com/faq/FAQ_58_10188
portal_description:
xorg-x11-drv-mga is a video driver for the X.Org implementation of the X
Window System, for Matrox G-series chips.

This update adds support for new versions of the ServerEngines Pilot server
management controller. These controllers use Matrox G-series chips for
their integrated graphics sub-system.

All users of the xorg-x11-drv-mga driver should upgrade to this updated
package.
